title: TrueSkin: Towards Fair and Accurate Skin Tone Recognition and Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification accuracy, mean squared error (MSE), and confusion matrices of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on the TrueSkin dataset to detect misclassification and prediction error patterns across six true skin tone categories.

Prompting image generation models with specific target skin tones while varying unrelated contextual attributes (such as hairstyles, clothing, and environmental backgrounds) to measure how these contextual prompts spuriously skew the generated skin tones.
